content: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. The information provided here is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health concerns. Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to make informed comparisons. The information provided above is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
